integrity: The normalized equations and the symmetric-to-Lorenz affine equivalence were checked in a complete open-access rigorous-chaos article. The strongest prior localization paper was inspected in full and was found to contain the exact quadratic Lie derivative implying the integrated temperature-circle balance; that balance is explicitly excluded from the originality claim. The new current-acceleration identities were independently reconstructed from stationarity and replayed with the packaged exact checker. No numerical trajectory experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures for the autonomous constant-p Vallis model.
The periodically forced seasonal-cycle model is outside the stationary autonomous scope.
The temperature-circle balance is prior-implied by a published quadratic Lie-derivative calculation and is not claimed as new.
The result constrains conditional means and second-order statistics but does not determine a full invariant density or prove chaos for arbitrary parameters.
A differently phrased current-regression or acceleration-budget identity could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Exact stationary current-acceleration budget and equilibrium rigidity in the Vallis model
